## Experience

## Projects

- Kshitij — Beach Safety App. Kotlin and Python. Real-time ML and geo-visualization application; runner-up in Smart India Hackathon 2024 among 47,000+ teams.
- Bawarchi — Recipe Generator. RAG and Flask. Generates recipes from image/text prompts and adapts results to dietary preferences and available ingredients.
- Serene Sleep App. Java and TensorFlow. Snoring/drowsiness detection using YOLOv5 and YamNet, deployed on GCP; Top 100 in Google Solution Challenge 2024, India.
- Women Safety App. Java and Android. Emergency alerts through shake detection and real-time tracking via Maps API.
- Face Recognition Model. Python and dlib. Trained on 1,000+ images using 289-point facial vector encoding; 2nd place in an inter-college challenge with 50+ teams.
